blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — The Baguio migrant, who became celebrated for producing giant crocheted mandalas, has won a Guinness World Record. Adelaida Guia was notified by email on Thursday that she had officially set the record for single-handedly crocheting a massive mandala with a total area of 29 square meters or about 6 meters in diameter. “My five children Ezekiel, Jeniel, Danielli, Azriel and Giddiel are super happy for me,” she told the Inquirer on Friday. A former call center employee in Manila before she, her husband Philip, and their brood of aspiring artists migrated to Baguio in 2016, Guia first caught […]...
